description: Defines a custom Orleans grain class 'CustomDirectoryGrain' which implements the ICustomDirectoryGrain interface, providing directory-related functionalities such as ping, reset, and retrieving runtime instance IDs.

classes.name: CustomDirectoryGrain
classes.description: An Orleans grain class implementing directory functionalities, maintaining a counter and providing methods for ping, reset, and obtaining silo address.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: Increments and returns the current counter value asynchronously.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the counter to zero asynchronously.

methods.name: GetRuntimeInstanceId
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the silo address asynchronously.

methods.name: ProxyPing
methods.description: Delegates ping call to another grain implementing ICommonDirectoryGrain interface.
